title: Make independent diffusion documents promotable

problemStatement: The live dry-run reached 37 validated facts, 19 structural evidence items, and 178 discovered documents, but Microsoft remained only a Candidate because independent diffusion sources were zero. Direct inspection showed that PwC's reachable customer disclosure uses site-specific pwcReleaseDate metadata that the bounded date parser ignores, while the configured NIQ disclosure returned HTTP 403. The system must promote valid customer-owned documents without weakening the four-family gate or treating supplier-controlled material as independent.
outOfScope: Changing the four-family gate thresholds, Ranking semantics, Stage semantics, or counter-evidence policy
Adding an unbounded crawler, paid search provider, LLM judgment, guessed URLs, or new external provider
Changing SEC acquisition, Telegram publication, data-branch writes, repository secrets, or production scheduling
Treating supplier-controlled Microsoft pages, discovery articles, or social posts as independent customer disclosure
Claiming the product goal is achieved solely because a parser or source configuration test passes

riskAssessment.reason: Promoting a real customer disclosure is necessary for research value, but a broad date or subject heuristic could create false diffusion evidence. The fix must stay bounded, preserve effective-date provenance, keep supplier material separate, preserve legacy snapshots, and prove behavior through fixtures and the complete governed lifecycle.

reasons: The Work Item changes authoritative evidence promotion and the hard reference-model gate input boundary.

executionDecision.reason: The live failure is reproducible, the bounded sources and parser boundary are known, acceptance is testable, and no unresolved question blocks implementation.

intent.problem: The live report has enough structural evidence to investigate Microsoft, but valid customer-owned disclosures are being lost before the independent diffusion gate because the parser misses site-specific release metadata and one configured source is unavailable. This blocks the product's ability to identify a real AI-era reference model.
constraints: Keep the four-family gate, fail-closed Ranking behavior, and supplier-versus-independent source roles unchanged.
Only explicitly configured bounded URLs may be fetched; do not add crawling, guessed URLs, paid search, or LLM judgment.
Preserve effective-date provenance and legacy snapshot deserialization; malformed metadata must not be guessed.
Rust owns classification and evidence semantics; Python and Shell only orchestrate and verify.
Complete the full local, CI, PR, merge, closure, and post-merge trigger workflow with evidence.
intent.rationale: A narrowly scoped date/document promotion fix can turn the observed reachable customer disclosures into auditable evidence while preserving the hard gate that prevents supplier marketing from becoming independent corroboration.

preReviewWarnings: Do not broaden generic date matching to arbitrary metadata without a bounded allowlist and precedence test.
Do not count two URLs on a supplier-controlled domain as independent customer disclosure.
A successful gate is not evidence that the product goal is achieved until the live report contains a confirmed, source-bound company claim.

checkpointPolicy.reason: Record contract readiness before code and final evidence before lifecycle finish.

acceptance: document_metadata recognizes bounded site-specific publication metadata including pwcReleaseDate and prefers release/published dates over modified dates; malformed values remain rejected without guessing.
Bounded direct document classification recognizes the explicit Atos press URL and does not create additional URLs through crawling or guessing.
The registry replaces the inaccessible NIQ independent URL with the explicit Atos Group customer-owned disclosure while retaining PwC; supplier Microsoft URLs remain supplier attribution.

An authoritative independent document with a sentence such as 'PwC deploys Microsoft Copilot...' or 'Atos is rolling out Microsoft 365 Copilot...' yields an IndustryDiffusion candidate with a bounded named adopter and IndependentCustomerDisclosure role.
Regression tests prove supplier-only material remains insufficient, independent source roles survive normalization, legacy deserialization remains readable, and the four-family gate is unchanged.
Python and Shell remain limited to orchestration and verification; Rust owns date parsing, source classification, named-adopter extraction, evidence metadata, and judgment inputs.

All declared local quality gates, canonical finish, PR checks, hosted CI, merge, Work Item closure, and one post-merge dry-run complete with evidence; any failure is repaired in scope before progression.
guidelines: New public APIs must be documented.
Keep source-role classification and evidence promotion deterministic in Rust.
Use only explicitly configured bounded URLs for cross-origin sources.
Preserve supplier attribution, independent customer disclosure, regulatory/IR, and discovery-only roles as distinct evidence states.
Do not weaken fail-closed gates or infer confirmation from source availability alone.
Use Python and Shell only for bounded orchestration, fixtures, and verification.
